The `?: release.publishedAt.take(10)` fallback never kicks in here because parsing succeeds. Note `GithubRelease.publishedAt` can carry non-GitHub-standard values (mapper: `publishedAt ?: createdAt ?: ""`), so guard the conversion: only pass strings that actually carry a time/zone component through `formatIsoDate`, and show date-only input verbatim.
